package: W150-01 — AbovePrompt select keyboard and field hooks
question: How do the AbovePrompt input and select fields store edits and picked values, and how does the pane intercept keys before the render?
answer: Sixteen blocks (5,032 units) carry the select keyboard and its field hooks: isTypedText plus the control-character pattern, the per-site field store hook, the input-field hook (change/submit dispatch, ref-then-state text, duplicate-submit guard), the field-key classifiers, the pre-dispatch keys-ahead handler, optionText and the select key handlers, the select-field hook (highlight wrap, pick dispatch and answered-value apply, typed-ahead prefix match, Ctrl+C close/clear), the terminal ui.select dispatch, focusableAt, and the controlled-state hook with its two function tests. Names are the AbovePrompt module's export table.

behavior.typedText: k0: no ctrl/meta/super/escape/tab/return and the key matches /^[^\p{C}\p{Z}]+$/u; QT tests the escape/lone-surrogate/placeholder pattern
behavior.fieldKeys: rK claims arrows, home/end/delete/page keys and ctrl+'abdefhknpuwy'/meta+'bdfy' chords (the source returns undefined on some short-circuit misses); sK claims non-empty text without ctrl/meta/super/tab/return/escape and without QT
behavior.siteFields: C0 reads the generation once, seeds state from store.get()?.get(siteKey) ?? new Map, and writes it back in an effect while the generation is unchanged; returns [map, setter]
behavior.inputFields: nK keeps a ref map and submitted set, prunes on v0 Input changes, edit sets ref+state and dispatches ui.input kind change, textNow reads ref then state then the caller value else '', submit guards duplicates, dispatches kind submit, then clears only when the dispatch answered undefined and the value is unchanged
behavior.keysAhead: lK registers through Ey; hostile cases: null service/context, wheel, not ahead; resolve current context and run its handler on a match; focused Select goes through selectKeys; a Global match stops; focused Input handles backspace/text/own keys; a rendered-context match or a focused Input taking field keys returns true
behavior.selectFields: uK reads the picked-value store via C0, tracks {key,isOpen,highlight} with fd, wraps the highlight modulo max(1,count), press picks the highlighted option and dispatches selectFromTerminal applying the answer only if the pick is unchanged, typed text runs a case-folded prefix search after the highlight, Ctrl+C closes an open select else clears focus
behavior.selectHandlers: Nne maps highlightNext/highlightPrevious to move(1)/move(-1) and press to press
behavior.focusableAt: Ihe: null for a null index, list[index] ?? null otherwise
behavior.controlledState: fd seeds once from a value or initializer, returns [value, setter, getter]; setter accepts a value or updater; kd/Md test functions
